changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce n_whatsapp_log.status at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_whatsapp_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_whatsapp_log_status CHECK (status IS NULL OR status IN ('SENT', 'RECEIVED'))

changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce n_whatsapp_log.message_type at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_whatsapp_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_whatsapp_log_message_type CHECK (message_type IS NULL OR message_type IN ('TEMPLATE', 'TEXT', 'INTERACTIVE', 'UNSUPPORTED', 'IMAGE', 'BUTTON', 'STICKER', 'AUDIO', 'CONTACTS', 'REACTION', 'DOCUMENT', 'VIDEO'))

changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce n_whatsapp_log.created_source at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_whatsapp_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_whatsapp_log_created_source CHECK (created_source IS NULL OR created_source IN ('API', 'BOT', 'SEQUENCE', 'BROADCAST'))

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_whatsapp_channel ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_whatsapp_channel_entity CHECK (entity IN ('LEAD', 'ADVISOR'))

changeSet.author: navigator
changeSet.comment: Guardrail: enforce n_whatsapp_log.sent_by at DB level
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE n_whatsapp_log ADD CONSTRAINT chk_n_whatsapp_log_sent_by CHECK (sent_by IS NULL OR sent_by IN ('API', 'SEQUENCE'))
